card.name: Citation and database record punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation, digits or spaces inside bibliographic and database-style records, such as after an author's initial, within a year, or in a call number. Found on botanical and library catalogue pages.

modes.label: Author and reference formatting
modes.description: The period after an author initial or a digit inside a year or page number in a citation.
modes.example: Hyde, M.A., Wursten, B.T. & Ballings, P<<. >>Flora of Zimbabwe: Species information:

modes.label: Website record fields
modes.description: Spacing or brackets right before a date or count in page metadata.
modes.example: Recent downloads (6 months<<)>>0 How can I increase my downloads

modes.label: Digits in catalogue numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a call number or publication year.

card.plain: It fires on small punctuation marks and digits in reference lists and catalogue records, such as years and call numbers.
